decision: Close all 6 dangling local branches without merging; none pushed a PR to GitHub or Gitea.
why: Triaged every branch with `git cherry github/main <branch>` plus targeted diffs against current GitHub main (19ef59b). agent/sync-extended-data-lock and codex/extended-data-release-hygiene-fix touch only uv.lock + PUBLISHING_CHECKLIST.rst action-pin bumps that are stale relative to main's current lockfile (deps bumped many times since). codex/preserved-local-main-25f8c5c has exactly one unique commit (25f8c5c, 2026-06-09 'ci: add release workflow and pin actions') and main already has a superset (release.yml, release-please-config.json, .release-please-manifest.json, CHANGELOG.md). codex/workspace-pytest-extended-data's root->packages/extended-data + packages/pytest-extended-data restructuring is already fully present on main (verified packages/ layout matches). codex/pytest-plugin-publish-workflow's separate cd-pytest-extended-data.yml publish workflow is superseded by main's more elegant unified cd.yml with a `package` workflow_dispatch input already handling both extended-data and pytest-extended-data publication, dispatched from release.yml by package-specific release-please outputs. codex/extended-data-polymorphic-container's factory double-init guard fix (per-container _FACTORY_INITIALIZED_ATTR checks in ExtendedDict/ExtendedList/ExtendedSet __init__) is superseded by a more general fix already on main: ExtendedData.__init_subclass__ wraps every subclass __init__ with a single reentry guard, with matching test coverage in packages/extended-data/tests/core/test_containers.py (lines 27, 524-555). Verified empirically: `ExtendedData({'a':1,'b':[1,2,3]})` and `ExtendedData([1,2,3])` construct correctly with no double-init on current main. The branch's docs .md->.rst migration is also superseded by main's already-restructured packages/extended-data/docs/*.rst tree. Ran full test suite on main first as baseline: 802 passed. All 6 branches were local-only (git branch -vv showed origin tracking refs already [gone] or branch never pushed) — no GitHub PR or Gitea branch existed to formally close, so no gh pr close action was needed. Deleted the 6 local branches after confirming supersession to leave nothing dangling.
resolves: team-lead directive: finish jbcom/extended-data, merge or close all 6 unmerged branches
